title: BERGSHULT shelf
description: BERGSHULT shelf, walnut effect, 311/2x77/8" This walnut-patterned shelf helps you create a storage solution with a few, simple steps – and change the style anytime. The edge on one side is beveled while the other is smooth, just turn it and see!
features: Complete with 2 brackets, placed at least 27½" apart. Sold separately.
The shelf carries a max. of 22 lbs when properly mounted on the wall.
Max. load refers to the max. weight before the shelf is risking to slant. Distribute the weight evenly on the shelf to avoid the risk of slanting.
If you are uncertain about what type of mounting devices to use, please contact your local hardware store.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
materialAndCare: Particleboard, Paper foil, Plastic edging, Plastic edging
